data.summary: Xu et al. introduce a comprehensive evaluation framework for LLM logical reasoning across 15 datasets and seven model families, proposing answer and explanation metrics plus five error types to isolate reasoning quality from content bias.
data.limitations:
The source authors state: "Overall, it can be observed that all LLMs exhibit specific
limitations in logical reasoning, with relative strength in
deductive reasoning but evident struggles in inductive
settings."
data.abstract: Xu et al. present a systematic evaluation of LLM logical reasoning capabilities across multiple reasoning types, datasets, and model families, introducing fine-grained metrics and error taxonomy to isolate logical from content-driven performance.
data.introduction: Xu et al. propose a comprehensive evaluation framework for LLM logical reasoning abilities across 15 datasets and seven model families.
data.conclusion: ChatGPT exhibits stronger and consistent competitiveness, ranking first in deductive, inductive, and mixed-form settings.
